nodes.summary: For every real number $a \ge 0$, the center density $\delta_4$ of sphere packings in $\mathbb{R}^4$ is at most $a$ if and only if the sphere-packing density $\Delta_4$ of $\mathbb{R}^4$ is at most $\pi^2 a / 2$.
nodes.title: Center-density upper bounds as packing-density upper bounds

nodes.summary: The center density of sphere packings in $\mathbb{R}^4$ is $\delta_4 = \Delta_4 / \operatorname{vol}(B)$, where $\Delta_4$ is the sphere-packing density of $\mathbb{R}^4$ and $B$ is the open unit ball of $\mathbb{R}^4$ centered at the origin; the quotient is taken in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Center density in four dimensions

nodes.summary: For every packing $P$ of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$ and every radius $R > 0$, the density of $P$ at radius $R$ (the supremum over all centers $p \in \mathbb{R}^4$ of the density of $P$ in the open ball of radius $R$ about $p$) is at most $1$.
nodes.title: The density at a fixed radius is at most one

nodes.summary: For a packing $P$ of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$ and a radius $R > 0$, the density of $P$ at radius $R$ is the supremum, over all centers $p \in \mathbb{R}^4$, of the density of $P$ in the open ball of radius $R$ about $p$; it is a value in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Density of a packing at a fixed radius

nodes.summary: For every packing of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$, the set of centers of its balls is countable.
nodes.title: A packing has countably many centers

nodes.summary: For every packing $P$ of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$, every point $p \in \mathbb{R}^4$ and every radius $R > 0$, the density of $P$ in the open ball of radius $R$ about $p$ is at most $1$.
nodes.title: The density in a ball is at most one

nodes.summary: For a packing $P$ of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$, a point $p \in \mathbb{R}^4$ and a radius $R > 0$, the density of $P$ in the open ball $B(p, R)$ of radius $R$ about $p$ is $\operatorname{vol}(U \cap B(p, R)) / \operatorname{vol}(B(p, R))$, where $U$ is the union of the closed balls of $P$ and $\operatorname{vol}$ is Lebesgue measure; the quotient is taken in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Density of a packing in a ball

nodes.summary: A packing $P$ of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$ is periodic if there are a basis $b_1, b_2, b_3, b_4$ of $\mathbb{R}^4$ and a finite set $F \subseteq \mathbb{R}^4$ such that the set of centers of $P$ equals $\{c + w : c \in F, w \in \Lambda\}$, where $\Lambda$ is the set of integer linear combinations of $b_1, b_2, b_3, b_4$.
nodes.title: Periodic packings

nodes.summary: The sphere packing density $\Delta_4$ of $\mathbb{R}^4$, the supremum of the upper densities of all packings of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$, satisfies $\frac{\pi^2}{16} \le \Delta_4$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for sphere packing in dimension four

nodes.summary: The proposition that the sphere packing density $\Delta_4$ of $\mathbb{R}^4$, the supremum of the upper densities of all packings of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$, satisfies $\frac{\pi^2}{16} \le \Delta_4$.
nodes.title: Statement of the lower bound for sphere packing in dimension four

nodes.summary: The trivial lower bound holds: the sphere-packing density $\Delta_4$ of $\mathbb{R}^4$ satisfies $0 \le \Delta_4$.
nodes.title: The four-dimensional packing density is nonnegative

nodes.summary: This is the statement that the sphere-packing density $\Delta_4$ of $\mathbb{R}^4$ satisfies $0 \le \Delta_4$.
nodes.title: The trivial lower bound for the four-dimensional packing density

nodes.summary: For every point $p \in \mathbb{R}^4$ and every real $R > 0$, the open ball of radius $R$ centred at $p$ has finite Lebesgue measure.
nodes.title: Balls of positive radius in $\mathbb{R}^4$ have finite volume

nodes.summary: For every point $p \in \mathbb{R}^4$ and every real $R > 0$, the open ball of radius $R$ centred at $p$ has nonzero Lebesgue measure.
nodes.title: Balls of positive radius in $\mathbb{R}^4$ have nonzero volume

nodes.summary: For a packing $P$ in $\mathbb{R}^4$ with radius $r$ and a point $c \in \mathbb{R}^4$, the packed ball of $P$ at $c$ is the closed ball $\{x \in \mathbb{R}^4 : \|x - c\| \le r\}$, boundary included.
nodes.title: Packed ball

nodes.summary: For every packing $P$ in $\mathbb{R}^4$, the region covered by $P$, the union of its packed closed balls, is a Borel set; in particular it is Lebesgue measurable.
nodes.title: The region covered by a packing is measurable

nodes.summary: For a packing $P$ in $\mathbb{R}^4$ with radius $r$ and set of centres $C$, the region covered by $P$ is the union, over all centres $c \in C$, of the packed closed balls $\{x \in \mathbb{R}^4 : \|x - c\| \le r\}$.
nodes.title: Region covered by a packing

nodes.summary: A packing in $\mathbb{R}^4$ consists of a real radius $r > 0$ and a set $C \subseteq \mathbb{R}^4$ of centres such that for any two distinct centres $c, c' \in C$ the open balls of radius $r$ about $c$ and $c'$ are disjoint.
nodes.title: Packings of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$

nodes.title: Four-dimensional Euclidean space

nodes.summary: The sphere-packing density $\Delta_4 \in [0, \infty]$ is the supremum, over all packings $P$ of congruent balls in $\mathbb{R}^4$, of the upper density of $P$. Here the upper density of $P$ is the limit superior, as the real radius $R > 0$ tends to infinity, of the supremum over all points $p \in \mathbb{R}^4$ of the ratio of the volume of the part of the open ball $B(p, R)$ covered by $P$ to the volume of $B(p, R)$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
